name: Eleanor's Lounge

evidence.note: Reviewers describe a bar with live music and a dance floor; one notes the dance area is small.
Event list shows weekly 'Karaoke and Dance Party' nights and Friday dance bands.
Copies of the bar's posts promote a country day where the band plays line dance hits, and bands that keep people dancing.
Venue site lists Miss Mayhem on Oct 3, 8-11 PM, $5 cover.

dancing.notes: Eleanor's has a dance floor, though reviewers say it is on the small side. Weekend bands and DJ dance parties get people dancing, and country band days feature line dance songs.

description: A long-running lounge on Sunrise Highway in Bohemia, popular with an over-40 crowd. It has live bands on weekends, karaoke, bingo and DJ dance nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Map listings show (631) 244-7090; the venue's own website shows 631-256-7443, which we used.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The lounge now brands itself 'The New Eleanor's Lounge'. Map listings show (631) 244-7090; the venue's own site shows 631-256-7443 on every page, which we kept. A map listing also shows Monday 5-8 PM, but the site says closed Monday. The site also links a Facebook group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/676091942419597), not recorded as the page. The only real interior photo on the site is a blurry background image under a heavy purple tint (dance floor with a disco ball), so no photos were saved; all other images are text-heavy band flyers. The YouTube channel comes from the site's own schema data; we could not check how active it is.
hours: Tue 6:30 PM-11 PM; Wed-Thu and Sun 6:30 PM-midnight; Fri-Sat 6:30 PM-1 AM; closed Mon

logo.alt: The New Eleanor's Lounge logo in white letters on black, with a martini glass and music notes

evidence.note: Lounge contact page: 4103 Sunrise Hwy, Bohemia NY 11716, 631-256-7443, eleanorslounge@gmail.com, and opening hours (closed Monday).

Home page lists karaoke Sundays/Wednesdays/Thursdays, Tuesday bingo and live bands on Fridays and Saturdays (e.g. 1984, Killin Time, The Mechanix) in Oct-Nov 2026; links Facebook, X and Instagram, and its schema data adds a YouTube channel.
Places listing for Eleanor's Lounge (bar) matches the address and the same Facebook and Instagram pages, but shows phone (631) 244-7090.
